::: {#sol-expression-or-algorithm-part5}

$(a x + b)\,x + c$, Horner's form.
It uses two multiplications and two additions, where the first form,
with $x^2$ computed as $x \cdot x$, uses three multiplications and two additions.
The two [expressions](#def-expression) denote the same [function](functions.qmd#def-function) and describe different [algorithms](#def-algorithm).

:::
